title: every block you pick will be under you
description: a simple data pack by BHM that make every block you pick up become under you
body:
Walk on any block you're holding!

## How it works
Simply hold any block in your hand and walk — it will automatically place under your feet as you move.

## Features
- No commands needed
- Works with any placeable block
- Lightweight — no lag
- Plug and play

## Requirements
- No mods needed — datapack only!
